outline: 先修課程:負責教授同意。自動化機械之機構、感測器與驅動器介面技術、可程式控制程式設計及應用、作實際自動化機械之模擬、分析及設計專題。
schedule:
1 Introduction To Control Systems
2 Introduction To Microprocessor-Based Control

8 Actuators: Electric, Hydraulic And Pneumatic
9 Midterm Test
10-11 Human Machine Interfacce
12-14 Programmable Logic Controller
15 Quiz 1
16-17 Servo Motor & Controller
18 Final Test
